name: Beszel
longDescription:
Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform with Docker statistics, historical data and alerts. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration and is ready to use out of the box. It tracks CPU, memory, disk, network, temperature, GPU and per-container usage, supports multiple users, OAuth/OIDC login, automatic backups and a REST API.

Beszel has two parts: the hub (this app), which shows the dashboard, and a small agent that runs on each machine you want to monitor. Add a system from the hub to get the agent command for that machine.
description: Lightweight server monitoring hub with Docker stats, historical data and alerts
